title: Automated SLA & GPU Recommendation Assistant for Enterprise Dedicated Intake
creator: Elena Park
description: Build an assistant that automates the enterprise dedicated-capacity intake triage by suggesting SLA targets, reserved throughput tiers, and GPU-class recommendations. The assistant will ingest the customer intake form (workload profile, expected QPS/tokens, latency SLOs, data residency, budget constraints, and model family), cross-reference historical telemetry and cost models, and output a recommended configuration (SLA latency percentile targets, reserved throughput, recommended GPU family + node counts, and a default scaling policy). This ticket scopes the PM-side definition, acceptance criteria, evaluation rubric, and the first pass Confluence spec + demo dataset for eng to implement the recommendation engine.
acceptance_criteria: Spec doc linked in Confluence with inputs/outputs and decision rules
Prototype suggestion UI in intake form that returns 3 ranked configs (conservative, balanced, aggressive)
Recommendation includes: SLA target (p50/p95/p99), reserved throughput (tokens/s or rps), GPU family recommendation, initial node count, and suggested autoscale policy
Benchmarks: recommendations align with historical customer outcomes for 8/10 sampled customers in our demo dataset
Cost delta estimate provided for each recommended config and clear tradeoffs documented
Handoff checklist for ENG includes telemetry dataset, scoring function, and integration contract
